title: SeaS: Few-Shot Industrial Anomaly Image Generation with Separation and Sharing Fine-Tuning
mechanism: Stable Diffusion fine-tuned with an unbalanced prompt (one normal token, several anomaly tokens), decoupled anomaly alignment and normal alignment losses; masks from fused U-Net and VAE features.
adaptation: Fine-tune on rare blobby classes (splice, material, corrosion, inactive) with grey replicated to 3 channels at 512 px; do not use for 1-2 px cracks (latent 8x downsampling); generated masks checked against the house ensemble.
min_experiment: Arm: PF + SeaS samples for splice/material/corrosion, 5 seeds. Baseline: PF 5 seeds. Metric: mIoU_rob and splice IoU (0.000 now). Kill: mIoU_rob gain < +0.01 and splice still 0.
evidence: R: +12.79% IoU for supervised segmentation, +8.66% pixel AP for synthesis-based AD, on MVTec AD few-shot.
